name: Series 65E Heat Detectors With Flashing LED
family: Context Plus UL EU Approved Series 65E Detectors
summary: The Context Plus Conventional Series 65E Heat Detector monitors temperature by using a dual thermistor network which provides a voltage output proportional to the external air temperature. Wide-operating voltage of 9–33VDC. Wide-operating and storage temperature of -20°C to +60°C. Can be used on security systems. Proven detection performance. Can be used for applications where smoke detectors are unsuitable. Ideal for environments that are dirty or smoky under natural conditions. Wide operating voltage. Flashing LED.
